en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from Hammad, from Al Halby, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘My<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> bought a land and stipulated upon its owner that he<sup>asws</sup> would give him silver (Dirhams), every Dinar with ten Dirhams’.
en.sarwar: 18. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Um ay r from Hammad from al-Halabiy who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
My father purchased a piece of land and stipulated with the owner to pay him wariq (dirham) and dinar for ten dirham.”’
